_note: A representative review of a REAL, pinned MCP server (github/github-mcp-server @ c36e4e4493c7, 2026-07-10). Tools are a representative subset of ~100; verdicts reflect a least-privilege review. sha256 is the distributed container image digest (the server ships as ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server).

residuals.finding: handle_security not established: cross-call handle generation and binding were not verified (2026-07-28 stateless core).
residuals.why_unenforceable: Whether handles are CSPRNG-generated, user-bound and expiring is internal server state; a traffic gateway never observes it.
residuals.compensating_control: Source review or vendor attestation before approval; re-check on any version bump.

residuals.finding: Tasks extension not policed at method granularity if the server adopts it.
residuals.why_unenforceable: pipelock mcp_tool_policy matches tool names (tool_pattern), not JSON-RPC methods, and request_policy matches HTTP route only, so tasks/get and tasks/cancel are indistinguishable from any other POST to the MCP endpoint.
residuals.compensating_control: Deny or warn the tools that spawn tasks (those ARE name-matchable); watch pipelock for a method matcher.
